# Balinsky

> Balinsky (balinsky.info) is a Bali property marketplace for foreign buyers — people without an Indonesian passport. Everything listed is leasehold, the legal way for a foreigner to hold villas and apartments in Bali. As of November 2026: about 460 villas ($77K to $6.5M), 510 apartments ($65K to $1.6M) and 345 residential complexes from developers, each with price, leasehold term, land zone, PBG/SLF permit status and Balinsky's own rental-yield estimate. Site in 10 languages (en, ru, id, fr, de, zh, nl, pl, uk, ban).
>
> Balinsky is an information and analytics site, not a seller or broker: it does not take part in deals or take commission. Yields quoted anywhere on the site and in its AI files are Balinsky's own estimate (before tax, and for a non-resident), calculated from comparable rentals nearby (Booking and Airbnb data). Developer-claimed yields appear only labelled as such.
>
> Балинский — маркетплейс недвижимости Бали для иностранцев: всё в лизхолде, с документами (PBG, SLF), сроком аренды земли и собственным расчётом доходности. Balinsky объекты не продаёт и в сделках не участвует.

## Buying in Bali as a foreigner — guides

- [How to buy property in Bali as a foreigner](https://balinsky.info/en/how-to-buy): step by step — leasehold vs PT PMA, due diligence, PPAT notary, taxes and fees.
- [Leasehold vs freehold: what a foreigner can hold](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/leasehold-freehold-bali-foreigner-can-hold-2026): Hak Sewa, Hak Pakai, PT PMA — what each gives you.
- [How long are Bali leaseholds — 320 villas](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-leasehold-terms-price-per-year-data): typical lease terms and price per year of lease, from listing data.
- [Leasehold extension](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-leasehold-extension-how-it-works): how extension works and what to put in the contract.
- [6 rules of a leasehold contract](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-leasehold-contract-6-rules): clauses that protect your money.
- [The real cost of buying a villa](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/cost-of-buying-villa-bali-taxes-fees-2026): taxes, notary, legal and running costs on top of the price.
- [Property taxes for foreigners](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-property-taxes-buying-owning-renting-selling): buying, owning, renting out, selling.
- [Bali land zones and colours (RDTR)](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-land-zones-colors-codes-rdtr-investors): pink, yellow, green — where short-term rental is allowed.
- [PBG and SLF permits](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/pbg-building-permit-indonesia-matters-risks-without): what they mean, how to check, how many villas have them.
- [Checking a developer: 12 points](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/how-check-developer-bali-12-point-checklist): before paying a deposit.
- [Where to buy: Canggu vs Uluwatu vs Ubud vs Sanur](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/where-to-buy-villa-bali-areas-compared-2026): prices by area, 2026.
- [Bali villa rental yield by area](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge/bali-villa-rental-yield-by-area-data): 350 sale prices against 6,300 rentals.

## For AI agents / machine-readable text

Any page has a clean text and structured view — append `.md` or `.json` to its URL:

- `https://balinsky.info/en/villas.md` — page as Markdown (headings, text, numbers)
- `https://balinsky.info/en/villas.json` — structured `{title, description, headings, blocks, text, numbers}`
- Works for every page and every language, e.g. `/de/villen.md`, `/en/complexes/<slug>.json`.

These views strip navigation, scripts and interactive widgets (maps, calculator,
the AI consultant). Listing pages start with a "Balinsky data" block: price, area,
bedrooms, land, leasehold, status and Balinsky's own yield estimate (before tax and
for a non-resident); a developer's claimed yield, if any, is shown labelled next to it.
The `.json` view carries the same figures under `balinsky`. Served to AI crawlers:
reverse-DNS verified, and by User-Agent for OpenAI (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot,
ChatGPT-User) and Perplexity (PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User).

**Semantic search** over the whole catalogue (villas, apartments, complexes,
developers, districts) — always current, reverse-DNS-verified crawlers only:

- `https://balinsky.info/api/llm/search?q=<query>` — e.g. `?q=2-bedroom villa in Canggu under $400k with strong rental yield`
- Returns ranked results with title, page URL, `.md` full-text URL, an investor summary and key facts. Optional `&kinds=villa,complex` and `&limit=15`.

**Full catalogue corpus** — every published listing with key facts, Balinsky's yield
estimate, a summary and links to its full text, one machine-readable file, always
current, **in any of the 10 languages** (links point to that language's pages):

- `https://balinsky.info/llms-full.txt` (English by default)
- `https://balinsky.info/llms-full.txt?lang=ru` (or en / id / fr / de / zh / nl / pl / uk / ban)
- Search also takes `&lang=`: `/api/llm/search?q=...&lang=zh`

- [Виллы и дома на Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/villy): каталог вилл от застройщиков с фильтрами по району, бюджету и срокам сдачи.
- [Villas and houses in Bali](https://balinsky.info/en/villas): catalog of villas with district, price-range and completion-year filters.
- [Апартаменты на Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/apartamenty): юниты в инвестиционных и резидентских комплексах.
- [Apartments in Bali](https://balinsky.info/en/apartments): units in investment and residential complexes.
- [Жилые комплексы на Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/zhilye-kompleksy): кондо- и виллов-комплексы с готовностью строительства и сроками сдачи.
- [Residential complexes in Bali](https://balinsky.info/en/complexes): condo and villa-style complexes with build progress and handover timelines.
- [Застройщики Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/zastrojshhiki): редакционно проверенные девелоперы с проектами, документами и менеджерами.
- [Bali developers](https://balinsky.info/en/developers): editorially vetted developers with projects, permits and managers.
- [Долгосрочная аренда](https://balinsky.info/ru/arenda): свежие предложения по месячной и годовой аренде.
- [Long-term rental](https://balinsky.info/en/rental): fresh monthly and yearly rental listings.
- [Villen auf Bali (DE)](https://balinsky.info/de/villen) · [Wohnanlagen](https://balinsky.info/de/wohnanlagen) · [Bauträger](https://balinsky.info/de/bautraeger)
- [巴厘岛别墅 (ZH)](https://balinsky.info/zh/bieshu) · [住宅区](https://balinsky.info/zh/zhuzhaiqu) · [开发商](https://balinsky.info/zh/kaifashang)
- [Villa's op Bali (NL)](https://balinsky.info/nl/villas) · [Wooncomplexen](https://balinsky.info/nl/wooncomplexen) · [Ontwikkelaars](https://balinsky.info/nl/ontwikkelaars)
- [Villa di Bali (ID)](https://balinsky.info/id/villa) · [Vila ring Bali (BAN)](https://balinsky.info/ban/vila)

## Pillar-страницы / Pillar pages

- [Инвестиции в недвижимость Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/investicii-v-nedvizhimost-bali): доходность, окупаемость, налоги, ставки аренды по районам.
- [Bali property investment guide](https://balinsky.info/en/bali-property-investment): yield, payback, taxes, district rental rates.
- [Как купить недвижимость на Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/kak-kupit): пошаговый разбор сделки — лизхолд, нотариус PPAT, документы PBG/SLF.
- [How to buy property in Bali](https://balinsky.info/en/how-to-buy): step-by-step deal walkthrough — leasehold, PPAT notary, PBG/SLF docs.
- [Жизнь на Бали](https://balinsky.info/ru/zhizn-na-bali): ВНЖ, налоги, школы, транспорт, коммунальные расходы.
- [Life in Bali](https://balinsky.info/en/living-in-bali): visa, taxes, schools, transport, utility costs.
- [База знаний](https://balinsky.info/ru/znaniya): статьи редакции по сделкам, рынку, юридическим нюансам.
- [Knowledge base](https://balinsky.info/en/knowledge): editorial articles on deals, market, legal details.

## Контент / Content

- [Новости рынка](https://balinsky.info/ru/novosti): новости застройщиков, разрешения, открытия.
- [News](https://balinsky.info/en/news): developer news, permits, openings.
- [Мероприятия](https://balinsky.info/ru/meropriyatiya): брокер-туры, презентации, нетворкинг от застройщиков.
- [Events](https://balinsky.info/en/events): broker tours, project presentations, developer networking.
- [Акции и спецпредложения](https://balinsky.info/ru/akcii): актуальные скидки и условия от девелоперов.
- [Promotions](https://balinsky.info/en/promo): live discounts and special terms from developers.

## Источники данных / Data sources

- Объекты и комплексы — собственная редакторская база с проверкой документов и съёмкой с земли.
- Доходность — собственный расчёт Balinsky (до налогов и для нерезидента) по аренде похожих объектов рядом: Booking-аналитика через estatemarket.io и помесячные объявления. Заявленная застройщиком доходность — только с пометкой.
- Карты и POI — Google Maps Places API.
